name: personal-glow-assistant
description: 一個會提醒、記錄並陪伴你的桌面貼身小助理
author: Max

scripts.build:helpers: npm run build:voice && npm run build:calendar
scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/voice-preload.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/voice.js && node --check src/voiceCommands.js && node --check src/voiceIntent.js && node --check src/voiceContext.js && node --check src/calendarSync.js && node --check src/eventDates.js && node --check src/utils.js && node --check src/nativeBridge.js && node --check src/aiVoice.js
scripts.package: npm run build:helpers && electron-packager . 貼身小秘書 --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=assets/app-icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.max.personalglowassistant --extend-info=build/Info.plist --extra-resource=build/VoiceRecognizer.app --extra-resource=build/CalendarBridge.app --ignore='^/dist($|/)' --ignore='^/build/VoiceRecognizer.app($|/)' --ignore='^/build/CalendarBridge.app($|/)' && npm run sign
scripts.sign: codesign --force --deep --sign "Glow Secretary Local Signing" 'dist/貼身小秘書-darwin-arm64/貼身小秘書.app'
scripts.notarize: echo 'Notarization requires Apple Developer account. Set APPLE_ID, APPLE_TEAM_ID, APPLE_APP_PASSWORD (or use @keychain:AC_PASSWORD), then follow README after npm run package.'
